title: Annual Average Loss from Tropical Cyclones and Earthquakes at village level for Niue
publisher: Pacific Community (SPC), Geoscience, Energy and Maritime Division
indicator: Estimated annual average direct economic loss
method: Losses averaged over 10,000 realizations of next-year activity; buildings, major infrastructure and valuable crops are included.
displayUse: The experience uses the dataset's village-scale framing and verified national AAL context. It does not assign unverified loss values to individual villages.
